subject: ISV integration: technical packaging and revenue matrix
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@platformiq.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya.rao@tangotech.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + resale packaging question

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the time on Friday. PlatformIQ is excited about the integration with Redwood’s lightweight runtime — our customers are asking for a packaged resale option where we can offer Redwood-backed inference as part of our managed offering.

Two quick asks to see if we can scope before a formal SOW:
1) A proposed packaging model (single-SKU vs. tiered SKUs) you recommend for embedded ISV resale.
2) A starting revenue split for first-year deals (we’d prefer something simple to start, e.g., 70/30 split but open to alternatives that protect existing inbound leads).

I attached a short description of PlatformIQ’s product bundles (PlatformIQ_Product_Packaging.pdf). Can you loop in the right folks on your side?

Best,
Samir Khan
Head of Partnerships | PlatformIQ
+1 415-555-0193

Attachment: PlatformIQ_Product_Packaging.pdf (PDF, 215KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@platformiq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + resale packaging question

Samir — thanks for sending this over and for the context. Looping in Ben (partner ops) and Camila (commercial) who will own the revenue mechanics and packaging details.

At a high level, from our experience with ISV resales we recommend starting with:
- Tiered SKU: Starter / Growth / Enterprise mapped to token quotas and support levels (keeps billing simple for your customers).
- Lead protection: 90-day registration window on inbound PlatformIQ-sourced leads, with a clear lead registration form and a 30-day conversion guard in the contract.
- Revenue split: For first-year transactions we can pilot 65/35 (PlatformIQ/Redwood) on net ARR for deals you originate; 55/45 for co-sourced/opportunity-sourced deals where Redwood adds the majority of technical integration.

I’m attaching a draft revenue matrix Ben put together (Draft_Revenue_Matrix_v1.xlsx). Ben — can you confirm operational constraints (min ARR threshold per deal to qualify for resell, invoice flow)?

Next steps: internal review of the SOW language and a quick 30-minute call to align on lead registration and tech packaging. Propose Wed 5/12 10am PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Draft_Revenue_Matrix_v1.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@platformiq.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + resale packaging question

Grace / Samir — quick operational notes from partner ops:

- Minimum qualifying ARR for resell: $25k ARR (below that we recommend referral-only).
- Billing model: Redwood invoices PlatformIQ monthly for consumed tokens under a consolidated reseller account; PlatformIQ invoices its end customers. We can support monthly usage reconciliation and a tiered billing ladder if required.
- Lead registration: as Grace proposed — 90-day registration period with a 30-day cure/claim period. We will need a lightweight intake form (HubSpot) and a registration cutoff timestamp tied to the original lead capture.
- On pricing cadence: if PlatformIQ wants to bundle credits or offer free trial months, we need to agree on cost-share for the first month (we usually split the marginal token cost pro rata).

Flagging one edge case: enterprise procurement often requests a rev-share cap/true-up annually. If that’s in scope for you, we can add language for annual reconciliation.

Operationally we’re fine with the pilot split Grace proposed (65/35 origination; 55/45 co-sourced), subject to legal sign-off.

Ben Carter
Head of Partner Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: PlatformIQ redline: reseller terms (PIQ v RDW redline)

Hi all — attaching a company redline to the reseller term draft (PIQ_DSL_Redline.docx). A few commercial items called out:

1) Lead registration window: we’d like to extend to 180 days for certain enterprise segments (verticals with long procurement cycles).
2) Revenue split waterfall: propose an early-bird uplift of +5% to PlatformIQ for deals closed within first 90 days of pilot launch.
3) Payment terms: net 60 to accommodate our billing cycles (we understand Redwood standard is net 30).

We’ve highlighted the clauses in the attached. Please let us know which items are deal-breakers vs. negotiable.

Regards,
Legal — PlatformIQ

Attachment: PIQ_DSL_Redline.docx (Word, 78KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@platformiq.com>, Legal - PlatformIQ <legal@platformiq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PlatformIQ redline: reseller terms (PIQ v RDW redline)

Thanks for the redline and callouts — appreciate the clarity. Quick internal positions:

- Lead registration: we can agree to a 180-day window for enterprise-segment opportunities if PlatformIQ commits to a named-account list for those verticals and shares procurement milestones quarterly. For standard SMB/Growth accounts we want to keep 90 days.
- Early-bird uplift: +5% to PlatformIQ for pilot launch makes sense as a promotional incentive; we’ll treat it as a one-time credit applied to the first invoice reconciliation.
- Payment terms: Redwood finance prefers net 30; net 60 is difficult at scale. We can accommodate net 45 for the pilot with a review at the three-month reconciliation. If net 60 is mandatory for PlatformIQ, we’ll need to build in an interest/accrual clause.

Camila and Ben — please prepare a short one-pager that captures the final pilot financials (deal thresholds, split, payment cadence, lead registration rules) so Samir can present to his CFO. Samir — can you confirm you have a named-account list for the enterprise bucket by end of day Monday (5/17)?

Propose we lock terms in a short pilot MSA + SOW and then move to a 60–90 day technical onboarding window. I’ll schedule the 30-minute alignment call for Wed 5/12 10am PT as proposed — sending an invite now.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
